data: What is the phoneme error rate of the red line when trained on 50% of the data in the right graph?

The question asks for the phoneme error rate of the red line when trained on 50% of the data in the right graph. The red line represents the Swahili system trained with MLing + BAB300. In the right graph, the red line is shown at approximately 45% on the y-axis when the percentage amount of training data is set to 50%. Therefore, the phoneme error rate of the red line when trained on 50% of the data is around 45%.
